Remark
[Remark 2.6] 1. ch9:2.6↗ prop:dc-ch9-2-5 section 1 furnishes a characterization of geodesics as critical points of the energy for all proper variations. In this sense geodesics can be thought of as solutions to a variational problem; such a characterization is not local but involves the behavior of the geodesic as a whole.
